problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 delivery routes through 10 distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the delivery must be processed and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the hub stops must be completed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (H5, 9) → (H1, 4) → (H8, 9) → (H3, 10) → (H9, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H2, 9) → (H6, 9) → (H4, 5) → (H7, 9)
* R2 requires the sequence: (H4, 9) → (H3, 3) → (H9, 2) → (H8, 6) → (H1, 7) → (H6, 2) → (H7, 3) → (H2, 1) → (H10, 7) → (H5, 9)
* R3 requires the sequence: (H1, 2) → (H5, 2) → (H6, 5) → (H2, 5) → (H10, 8) → (H8, 1) → (H9, 2) → (H4, 7) → (H3, 4) → (H7, 5)
* R4 requires the sequence: (H5, 2) → (H2, 7) → (H3, 5) → (H10, 6) → (H1, 5) → (H8, 1) → (H7, 3) → (H9, 8) → (H4, 6) → (H6, 4)
* R5 requires the sequence: (H4, 5) → (H2, 9) → (H7, 7) → (H3, 1) → (H5, 6) → (H1, 4) → (H9, 8) → (H6, 10) → (H8, 10) → (H10, 4)
* R6 requires the sequence: (H8, 2) → (H9, 6) → (H2, 7) → (H4, 7) → (H10, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H5, 3) → (H6, 6) → (H1, 7) → (H7, 7)
* R7 requires the sequence: (H9, 1) → (H5, 6) → (H4, 7) → (H7, 2) → (H2, 2) → (H1, 10) → (H8, 9) → (H10, 10) → (H3, 1) → (H6, 6)
* R8 requires the sequence: (H3, 3) → (H10, 8) → (H6, 3) → (H4, 8) → (H7, 3) → (H9, 7) → (H5, 9) → (H2, 6) → (H8, 6) → (H1, 2)
* R9 requires the sequence: (H1, 10) → (H3, 1) → (H6, 2) → (H9, 8) → (H8, 9) → (H2, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H7, 1) → (H5, 8) → (H4, 8)
* R10 requires the sequence: (H2, 5) → (H4, 5) → (H10, 1) → (H8, 6) → (H7, 10) → (H5, 1) → (H6, 6) → (H9, 3) → (H3, 7) → (H1, 2)

Each hub stop must be processed continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution hub can only handle one delivery stop at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all delivery stops at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
